purpose: Diagnose published RGB inference preprocessing, clipping and approximate tiling without selecting or training models
models: All three checksum-pinned hosted catalog entries; unchanged weights
inputs: 129x131 synthetic RGB ramps and hard edges
260x264 pinned NAIP training crop at column100,row100; Gaussian sigma0.8 and area x2 then uint8 RGB display quantization
split: train only; no validation selection and no test access
normalization: uint8 HWC RGB converted to float32 CHW /255; source crop fixed DN/10000 before synthetic degradation
measurements: float full-versus-tiled MAE and maximum absolute difference
interpretation: Differences measure implementation context, not HR accuracy. Global channel pooling makes tiled context approximate. Clipping/quantization are display transformations. No quality-gain, geographic generalization or default-model selection claim.
budget: CPU only, two threads, bounded inputs, three checkpoints, no optimizer steps or data downloads
